trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging, and also unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status: rolled out.
3. **Incident opened**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failed health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.
